name: app.R
content: # Recreational Boating Dashboard 1: Monthly Sales (units & value) with YoY comparison # Source: Kevin Decker | recreational boating dashboards library(shiny) library(readr) # ---- Data ---------------------------------------------------------------- # Expects a CSV with columns: year, month (1-12), units, value sales <- read_csv("boat_sales.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) month_names <- c("January","February","March","April","May","June", "July","August","September","October","November","December") # The newest month(s) in the data are still filling in (weekly upload lag), so the # dashboard opens on the latest COMPLETE month rather than the newest partial one. # If the lag ever exceeds one month, bump this to 2, 3, ... incomplete_trailing_months <- 1 sales_ord <- sales[order(sales$year, sales$month), ] default_idx <- max(1, nrow(sales_ord) - incomplete_trailing_months) default_year <- sales_ord$year[default_idx] default_month <- sales_ord$month[default_idx] # Rolling 12-month (R12 / trailing-twelve-months). Deterministic — anchored to the # latest complete month — so compute once at load. Reindexed to a gap-free monthly # series so each window is a true 12 calendar months even if a month were missing. R12 <- local({ sdate <- as.Date(sprintf("%d-%02d-01", sales_ord$year, sales_ord$month)) full <- data.frame(date = seq(min(sdate), max(sdate), by = "month")) full$units <- sales_ord$units[match(full$date, sdate)]; full$units[is.na(full$units)] <- 0 full$value <- sales_ord$value[match(full$date, sdate)]; full$value[is.na(full$value)] <- 0 n <- nrow(full) ru <- rv <- rep(NA_real_, n) if (n >= 12) for (i in 12:n) { ru[i] <- sum(full$units[(i - 11):i]); rv[i] <- sum(full$value[(i - 11):i]) } end_i <- max(1, n - incomplete_trailing_months) # latest complete month list(full = full, ru = ru, rv = rv, end_i = end_i, n = n) }) # Monthly totals by source (written by prepare_data.R). Optional: the Trends tab # shows a note if it hasn't been generated yet. by_source <- if (file.exists("boat_sales_by_source.csv")) { read_csv("boat_sales_by_source.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) } else NULL # Plain-language definitions of each Source of Sales category. # The order here also drives the dropdown order (New -> Used -> In-Migrant). source_defs <- c( "New Import" = "a new boat purchased from an out-of-state dealer.", "New Dealer" = "a new boat purchased from a WA dealer.", "Used Dealer" = "a used boat purchased from a WA dealer.", "Used Dealer Import" = "a used boat purchased from an out-of-state dealer.", "Used Import" = "a used boat purchased from an out-of-state private seller.", "Used Private" = "a used boat purchased from a WA private seller.", "In-Migrant" = "a new WA resident registers a boat brought into WA." ) # Categories to offer, in the definition order above; any unexpected value in the # data (e.g. a new or misspelled label) is appended so nothing is hidden. source_levels <- if (is.null(by_source)) character(0) else { present <- unique(by_source$source) c(names(source_defs)[names(source_defs) %in% present], sort(setdiff(present, names(source_defs)))) } # All-source monthly totals keyed "YYYY-MM" — used for a fixed axis ceiling and for # looking up the same month a year earlier (the prior-year reference). all_tot <- if (is.null(by_source)) NULL else { a <- aggregate(cbind(units, value) ~ year + month, data = by_source, FUN = sum) a$ym <- sprintf("%04d-%02d", a$year, a$month) a } # Month start-dates spanning the data, for the Transaction Date range slider. month_dates <- sort(as.Date(sprintf("%d-%02d-01", sales$year, sales$month))) date_min <- min(month_dates) # Stop the slider at the latest COMPLETE month — the newest still-filling month(s) # are excluded (same rule / setting as the Dashboard default) until they finish. last_complete_idx <- max(1, length(month_dates) - incomplete_trailing_months) date_max <- month_dates[last_complete_idx] # Default to roughly the most recent 13 complete months, like the reference view. default_start <- if (last_complete_idx >= 13) month_dates[last_complete_idx - 12] else date_min # ---- Helpers ------------------------------------------------------------- get_row <- function(df, yr, mo) { r <- df[df$year == yr & df$month == mo, ] if (nrow(r) == 0) return(NULL) r[1, ] } pct_change <- function(now, last) { if (is.null(last) || is.na(last) || last == 0) return(NA_real_) (now - last) / last * 100 } fmt_int <- function(x) if (is.null(x) || is.na(x)) "—" else format(round(x), big.mark = ",") fmt_money <- function(x) if (is.null(x) || is.na(x)) "—" else paste0("$", format(round(x), big.mark = ",")) fmt_pct <- function(x) if (is.na(x)) "—" else sprintf("%+.1f%%", x) # ---- Branding ------------------------------------------------------------ WSG_PURPLE <- "#4b2e83" # Washington Sea Grant purple # Header mark: use the logo if ANY image is in the www/ folder (Shiny serves www/), # preferring a logo-ish name; otherwise fall back to a text badge. So just drop the # Sea Grant Washington image into a "www" folder next to app.R — any name/format works. logo_file <- local({ if (!dir.exists("www")) return(NA_character_) imgs <- list.files("www", pattern = "(?i)\\.(png|jpe?g|svg|gif|webp)$") if (!length(imgs)) return(NA_character_) pref <- imgs[grepl("(?i)logo|wsg|sea.?grant", imgs)] if (length(pref)) pref[1] else imgs[1] }) # Print what was found at launch so it's easy to diagnose from the Console. if (is.na(logo_file)) { message("WSG logo: no usable image found in www/ (contents: ", paste(if (dir.exists("www")) list.files("www") else "", collapse = ", "), ") — using text badge.") } else { message("WSG logo: using www/", logo_file) } header_brand <- if (!is.na(logo_file)) { tags$img(src = logo_file, height = "62px", alt = "Washington Sea Grant", style = "display:block;") } else { tags$span("WSG", style = paste0("font-weight:800; font-size:1.5em; letter-spacing:1px; color:white; ", "background:", WSG_PURPLE, "; padding:4px 12px; border-radius:4px;")) } # Light watermark drawn on every chart so screenshots carry the WSG attribution. watermark <- function() { mtext("Washington Sea Grant (WSG)", side = 3, line = -1.1, adj = 0.99, col = "#c9c9c9", cex = 0.75, font = 2) } # ---- UI ------------------------------------------------------------------ ui <- fluidPage( title = "WSG Recreational Boating Dashboard", tags$div( style = paste0("display:flex; align-items:center; gap:16px; padding:10px 4px; ", "margin-bottom:10px; border-bottom:3px solid ", WSG_PURPLE, ";"), header_brand, tags$div( tags$div("Recreational Boating Dashboard", style = paste0("font-weight:700; font-size:1.2em; color:", WSG_PURPLE, ";")), tags$div("Washington State — monthly and rolling 12-month sales", style = "color:#555; font-size:0.9em;")) ), sidebarLayout( sidebarPanel( width = 3, selectInput("month", "Month", choices = setNames(1:12, month_names), selected = default_month), selectInput("year", "Year", choices = sort(unique(sales$year), decreasing = TRUE), selected = default_year) ), mainPanel( width = 9, tabsetPanel( tabPanel("Monthly Summary", h4(textOutput("caption")), tableOutput("summary"), tags$p(textOutput("last_updated"), style = "color:#888; font-size:0.85em; margin-top:8px;") ), tabPanel("Rolling 12-Mo", h4(textOutput("r12_caption")), tableOutput("r12_table"), tags$p("Rolling 12-month (R12) sums the trailing 12 months, so it removes ", "seasonality and shows the underlying year-over-year trend. Use the ", tags$b("Month"), " and ", tags$b("Year"), " selectors to move the window; ", "it stops at the latest complete month.", style = "color:#888; font-size:0.85em; margin:0 0 10px;"), h4("Rolling 12-month trend", style = "margin:6px 0;"), plotOutput("r12_units_plot", height = "250px"), plotOutput("r12_value_plot", height = "250px"), h4("Year-to-date", style = "margin:14px 0 6px;"), tableOutput("ytd_table") ), tabPanel("Trends", checkboxGroupInput("src", "Source of Sales", choices = source_levels, selected = source_levels, inline = TRUE), sliderInput("daterange", "Transaction Date", min = date_min, max = date_max, value = c(default_start, date_max), timeFormat = "%b %Y", width = "100%"), div(style = "white-space:nowrap;", checkboxInput("show_prev", "Show prior-year reference", value = TRUE)), tags$p("Checked sources are summed. Prior-year reference = same month one ", "year earlier (black tick). Definitions are on the ", tags$b("Source & Definitions"), " tab.", style = "color:#888; font-size:0.85em; margin:0 0 6px;"), h4("Boat Sales", style = "margin:6px 0;"), plotOutput("trend_units", height = "300px"), h4("Sales Value", style = "margin:6px 0;"), plotOutput("trend_value", height = "300px") ), tabPanel("Source & Definitions", h4("Source of Sales — definitions"), tags$ul( lapply(names(source_defs), function(nm) tags$li(tags$b(nm), " — ", source_defs[[nm]])) ), tags$hr(), h4("Data source"), tags$p( "The results include data obtained from the Washington State ", "Department of Licensing (DOL). DOL did not verify the accuracy ", "of the data or how it was used." ) ) ) ) ), tags$hr(style = "margin-top:18px;"), tags$p( HTML(paste0( "Produced by Washington Sea Grant (WSG) · University of Washington. ", "Data source: WA Department of Licensing. ", "© ", format(Sys.Date(), "%Y"), " Washington Sea Grant — not for redistribution or reuse without attribution.")), style = paste0("color:#777; font-size:0.8em; text-align:center; padding:4px 0 12px;") ) ) # ---- Server -------------------------------------------------------------- server <- function(input, output, session) { vals <- reactive({ yr <- as.integer(input$year) mo <- as.integer(input$month) cur <- get_row(sales, yr, mo) prev <- get_row(sales, yr - 1, mo) units_now <- if (is.null(cur)) NA else cur$units units_last <- if (is.null(prev)) NA else prev$units value_now <- if (is.null(cur)) NA else cur$value value_last <- if (is.null(prev)) NA else prev$value list( units_now = units_now, units_last = units_last, units_chg = pct_change(units_now, units_last), value_now = value_now, value_last = value_last, value_chg = pct_change(value_now, value_last) ) }) output$caption <- renderText({ paste0(month_names[as.integer(input$month)], " ", input$year, " (vs. ", as.integer(input$year) - 1, ")") }) # ---- Trends tab: monthly units & value (total of selected sources) over a range -- # Snap the slider handles to month starts (shared by the series and the axis ceiling). date_window <- reactive({ rng <- input$daterange c(as.Date(format(rng[1], "%Y-%m-01")), as.Date(format(rng[2], "%Y-%m-01"))) }) trend_labels <- function(dates) format(dates, "%b %Y") blank <- function(msg) { plot.new(); text(0.5, 0.5, msg, cex = 1.1) } # Build source x month matrices for the selected sources + prior-year totals. trend <- reactive({ if (is.null(by_source)) return(NULL) sel <- input$src if (length(sel) == 0) return(list(empty = "none")) srcs <- source_levels[source_levels %in% sel] # keep defined order/colors w <- date_window() d <- by_source[by_source$source %in% srcs, ] d$ym <- sprintf("%04d-%02d", d$year, d$month) d$date <- as.Date(paste0(d$ym, "-01")) dw <- d[d$date >= w[1] & d$date <= w[2], ] if (nrow(dw) == 0) return(list(empty = "nodata")) ym <- sort(unique(dw$ym)) months <- as.Date(paste0(ym, "-01")) umat <- tapply(dw$units, list(factor(dw$source, srcs), factor(dw$ym, ym)), sum) vmat <- tapply(dw$value, list(factor(dw$source, srcs), factor(dw$ym, ym)), sum) umat[is.na(umat)] <- 0; vmat[is.na(vmat)] <- 0 # Prior-year total (selected sources), same month one year earlier. sel_u <- tapply(d$units, d$ym, sum); sel_v <- tapply(d$value, d$ym, sum) prev_key <- sprintf("%04d-%02d", as.integer(substr(ym, 1, 4)) - 1, as.integer(substr(ym, 6, 7))) list(empty = FALSE, months = months, srcs = srcs, umat = umat, vmat = vmat, prev_u = as.numeric(sel_u[prev_key]), prev_v = as.numeric(sel_v[prev_key])) }) # Fixed y-axis ceilings from ALL-source totals (incl. prior year) in the window, so # deselecting a source shortens the stack instead of the panel rescaling to fill. axis_ceiling <- reactive({ if (is.null(all_tot)) return(list(units = 1, value_m = 1)) w <- date_window() d <- all_tot; d$date <- as.Date(paste0(d$ym, "-01")) win <- d[d$date >= w[1] & d$date <= w[2], ] if (nrow(win) == 0) return(list(units = 1, value_m = 1)) pk <- sprintf("%04d-%02d", as.integer(substr(win$ym, 1, 4)) - 1, as.integer(substr(win$ym, 6, 7))) u_look <- setNames(d$units, d$ym); v_look <- setNames(d$value, d$ym) list(units = max(c(win$units, u_look[pk]), 1, na.rm = TRUE), value_m = max(c(win$value, v_look[pk]), 1, na.rm = TRUE) / 1e6) }) output$trend_units <- renderPlot({ tr <- trend() if (is.null(tr)) { blank("No source data yet.\nRun prepare_data.R to generate boat_sales_by_source.csv."); return() } if (identical(tr$empty, "none")) { blank("Select at least one source."); return() } if (identical(tr$empty, "nodata")) { blank("No sales for this selection."); return() } tot <- colSums(tr$umat) # total across selected sources par(mar = c(5, 5, 1, 1)) bp <- barplot(tot, names.arg = trend_labels(tr$months), col = "#4a6fa5", border = NA, las = 1, cex.names = 0.8, ylab = "Units Sold", ylim = c(0, axis_ceiling()$units * 1.15)) watermark() text(bp, tot, labels = format(tot, big.mark = ","), pos = 3, cex = 0.8, xpd = TRUE) if (isTRUE(input$show_prev)) segments(bp - 0.45, tr$prev_u, bp + 0.45, tr$prev_u, col = "#111111", lwd = 2) }) output$trend_value <- renderPlot({ tr <- trend() if (is.null(tr)) { blank("No source data yet.\nRun prepare_data.R to generate boat_sales_by_source.csv."); return() } if (identical(tr$empty, "none")) { blank("Select at least one source."); return() } if (identical(tr$empty, "nodata")) { blank("No sales for this selection."); return() } tot <- colSums(tr$vmat) / 1e6 # total across selected sources, in $M par(mar = c(5, 6, 1, 1)) bp <- barplot(tot, names.arg = trend_labels(tr$months), col = "#6aa84f", border = NA, las = 1, cex.names = 0.8, ylab = "Price", yaxt = "n", ylim = c(0, axis_ceiling()$value_m * 1.15)) axis(2, at = axTicks(2), labels = paste0("$", axTicks(2), "M"), las = 1) watermark() text(bp, tot, labels = paste0("$", formatC(tot, format = "f", digits = 1), "M"), pos = 3, cex = 0.8, xpd = TRUE) if (isTRUE(input$show_prev)) segments(bp - 0.45, tr$prev_v / 1e6, bp + 0.45, tr$prev_v / 1e6, col = "#111111", lwd = 2) }) output$last_updated <- renderText({ mtime <- file.info("boat_sales.csv")$mtime # when prepare_data.R last wrote the file latest <- sales_ord[nrow(sales_ord), ] # newest month present in the data paste0("Data last updated ", format(mtime, "%b %d, %Y"), " · latest month in data: ", month_names[latest$month], " ", latest$year) }) output$summary <- renderTable({ v <- vals() data.frame( check.names = FALSE, " " = c("Boats Sold", "Sold Last Year", "Units Change (%)"), "Units" = c(fmt_int(v$units_now), fmt_int(v$units_last), fmt_pct(v$units_chg)), " " = c("Sales Value", "Value Last Year", "Value Change (%)"), "Value" = c(fmt_money(v$value_now), fmt_money(v$value_last), fmt_pct(v$value_chg)), stringsAsFactors = FALSE ) }, striped = TRUE, bordered = TRUE, align = "lrlr", width = "100%") # ---- Rolling 12-month tab ------------------------------------------------ # End the R12 window on the month picked in the sidebar, but never past the # latest COMPLETE month (so it can't anchor on the still-filling one). r12_end_i <- reactive({ target <- as.Date(sprintf("%d-%02d-01", as.integer(input$year), as.integer(input$month))) idx <- match(target, R12$full$date) if (is.na(idx)) idx <- R12$end_i min(idx, R12$end_i) }) output$r12_caption <- renderText({ ed <- R12$full$date[r12_end_i()] paste0("12 months ending ", format(ed, "%B %Y"), " vs. the prior 12 months") }) output$r12_table <- renderTable({ i <- r12_end_i() if (i < 12) return(data.frame(check.names = FALSE, "Note" = "Need 12 months of history ending on the selected month — pick a later month.")) cu <- R12$ru[i]; cv <- R12$rv[i] has_prev <- i >= 24 # need a full prior 12-month window pu <- if (has_prev) R12$ru[i - 12] else NA pv <- if (has_prev) R12$rv[i - 12] else NA df <- data.frame( check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, m = c("Boats Sold", "Sales Value"), c = c(fmt_int(cu), fmt_money(cv)), p = c(fmt_int(pu), fmt_money(pv)), ch = c(fmt_pct(pct_change(cu, pu)), fmt_pct(pct_change(cv, pv))) ) cur_lab <- paste0(format(R12$full$date[i - 11], "%b %Y"), "–", format(R12$full$date[i], "%b %Y")) prv_lab <- if (has_prev) paste0(format(R12$full$date[i - 23], "%b %Y"), "–", format(R12$full$date[i - 12], "%b %Y")) else "Prior 12 Mo" names(df) <- c(" ", cur_lab, prv_lab, "Change (%)") df }, striped = TRUE, bordered = TRUE, align = "lrrr", width = "100%") output$r12_units_plot <- renderPlot({ if (R12$end_i < 12) { blank("Not enough history for a 12-month rolling total."); return() } d <- R12$full$date[12:R12$end_i]; y <- R12$ru[12:R12$end_i] par(mar = c(4, 7, 1, 1)) # wider left margin for the axis title plot(d, y, type = "l", lwd = 2, col = "#4a6fa5", xlab = "", ylab = "", las = 1, ylim = c(0, max(y) * 1.08)) title(ylab = "R12 Units Sold", line = 5) # push title clear of the numbers watermark() i <- r12_end_i() # selected endpoint marker if (i >= 12) { md <- R12$full$date[i]; my <- R12$ru[i] abline(v = md, col = "#bbbbbb", lty = 2) points(md, my, pch = 19, col = "#4a6fa5") text(md, my, labels = format(round(my), big.mark = ","), pos = 2, cex = 0.85) } }) output$r12_value_plot <- renderPlot({ if (R12$end_i < 12) { blank("Not enough history for a 12-month rolling total."); return() } d <- R12$full$date[12:R12$end_i]; y <- R12$rv[12:R12$end_i] / 1e6 par(mar = c(4, 7, 1, 1)) plot(d, y, type = "l", lwd = 2, col = "#6aa84f", xlab = "", ylab = "", las = 1, yaxt = "n", ylim = c(0, max(y) * 1.08)) axis(2, at = axTicks(2), labels = paste0("$", axTicks(2), "M"), las = 1) title(ylab = "R12 Sales Value", line = 5) watermark() i <- r12_end_i() if (i >= 12) { md <- R12$full$date[i]; my <- R12$rv[i] / 1e6 abline(v = md, col = "#bbbbbb", lty = 2) points(md, my, pch = 19, col = "#6aa84f") text(md, my, labels = paste0("$", formatC(my, format = "f", digits = 1), "M"), pos = 2, cex = 0.85) } }) output$ytd_table <- renderTable({ ed <- R12$full$date[r12_end_i()] cy <- as.integer(format(ed, "%Y")); cm <- as.integer(format(ed, "%m")) ytd <- function(yr) { s <- sales[sales$year == yr & sales$month <= cm, ] c(units = sum(s$units), value = sum(s$value)) } cur <- ytd(cy); prv <- ytd(cy - 1) df <- data.frame( check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, m = c("Boats Sold", "Sales Value"), c = c(fmt_int(cur["units"]), fmt_money(cur["value"])), p = c(fmt_int(prv["units"]), fmt_money(prv["value"])), ch = c(fmt_pct(pct_change(cur["units"], prv["units"])), fmt_pct(pct_change(cur["value"], prv["value"]))) ) names(df) <- c(paste0("Jan–", month_names[cm]), paste0("YTD ", cy), paste0("YTD ", cy - 1), "Change (%)") df }, striped = TRUE, bordered = TRUE, align = "lrrr", width = "100%") } shinyApp(ui, server)

name: prepare_data.R
content:
# Prep step for Recreational Boating Dashboard 1
# Reads the full Rec Boating xlsx, keeps only the fields this dashboard needs,
# aggregates to monthly units + value, and writes a small boat_sales.csv.
# Re-run this whenever new data is added. Source: Kevin Decker | rec boating dashboards

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

# ---- Config --------------------------------------------------------------
# Point this at your live file. Update the path if it moves.
input_path  <- "/Users/kevindecker/Library/CloudStorage/GoogleDrive-kadecker@uw.edu/My Drive/Recreational Boating/Rec Boating Data.xlsx"
output_path <- "boat_sales.csv"            # monthly totals -> Monthly Summary tab
source_path <- "boat_sales_by_source.csv"  # monthly totals by source -> Trends tab

# Which date drives a "sale": use the transaction fields (default).
# To key off purchase instead, change to "Purchase Year" / (no month) below.
year_col   <- "Transaction Year"
month_col  <- "Transaction Month Value"   # numeric 1-12
value_col  <- "Purchase Cost"
source_col <- "Source of Sales"           # e.g. "Used Private", "New Dealer"

# ---- Read ----------------------------------------------------------------
message("Reading ", input_path, " ...")
raw <- read_excel(input_path, guess_max = 100000)

needed <- c(year_col, month_col, value_col, source_col)
missing <- setdiff(needed, names(raw))
if (length(missing) > 0) {
  stop("These expected columns weren't found: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "),
       "\nColumns in file: ", paste(names(raw), collapse = " | "))
}

# ---- Aggregate -----------------------------------------------------------
summary <- raw %>%
  transmute(
    year  = suppressWarnings(as.integer(.data[[year_col]])),
    month = suppressWarnings(as.integer(.data[[month_col]])),
    value = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[value_col]]))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(year), !is.na(month), month >= 1, month <= 12) %>%
  group_by(year, month) %>%
  summarise(
    units = n(),                          # boats sold = number of transactions
    value = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE),     # sales value = sum of purchase cost
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(year, month)

# ---- Monthly totals by source (for the Trends tab) -----------------------
by_source <- raw %>%
  transmute(
    year   = suppressWarnings(as.integer(.data[[year_col]])),
    month  = suppressWarnings(as.integer(.data[[month_col]])),
    value  = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[value_col]])),
    source = as.character(.data[[source_col]])
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(year), !is.na(month), month >= 1, month <= 12) %>%
  mutate(source = ifelse(is.na(source) | trimws(source) == "",
                         "Unknown", trimws(source))) %>%
  group_by(year, month, source) %>%
  summarise(units = n(), value = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(year, month, source)

# ---- Reconciliation check ------------------------------------------------
# Both files are cut from the same rows, so monthly units and value must match
# between the totals and the by-source file. A mismatch means a bad/partial
# upload — surface it loudly rather than ship it.
recon <- summary %>%
  rename(units_total = units, value_total = value) %>%
  left_join(by_source %>% group_by(year, month) %>%
              summarise(units_src = sum(units), value_src = sum(value), .groups = "drop"),
            by = c("year", "month"))

bad <- recon %>%
  filter(units_total != units_src | abs(value_total - value_src) >= 1)

if (nrow(bad) == 0) {
  message("Reconciliation OK: monthly units and value match between the totals and by-source files.")
} else {
  warning("RECONCILIATION MISMATCH in ", nrow(bad),
          " month(s) — check the source file. Offending rows:")
  print(as.data.frame(head(bad, 10)))
}

# ---- Write ---------------------------------------------------------------
write_csv(summary, output_path)
write_csv(by_source, source_path)
message("Working directory: ", getwd())
message("Wrote ", nrow(summary), " month rows to: ", normalizePath(output_path),
        "  (", min(summary$year), "-", max(summary$year), ")")
message("Wrote ", nrow(by_source), " source rows to: ", normalizePath(source_path))
message("Done. Open those files, or re-run app.R to see the update.")
print(tail(summary, 6))
